title: Weekly check-in: calendar, spreadsheet and Monday brief
goalText: Using the results for our 36 bootcamp learners, find who is falling behind and why, plan support for each gap, book our 3 mentors without clashes, and draft messages to learners and mentors. Do not send anything.

intent.summary: Run the weekly check-in: find who is slipping, book mentors, draft messages and produce the calendar, spreadsheet and Monday brief, without sending anything

deliverables.description: Per-learner skill gaps with source rows
Support plan linked to verified gaps
Booked mentor sessions as a calendar file (proposal only)
Mentor schedule as a spreadsheet with counts per mentor
One-page Monday brief for the coordinator

subgoals.outcome: Find skill gaps and at-risk learners
Match each verified gap to a support activity
Draft messages to learners and mentors, do not send
Produce the calendar, spreadsheet and Monday brief from verified results

capabilityNeeds.reason: Place mentor sessions in availability windows
Write drafts for a person to review

effectClaims.description: Read synthetic inputs without changing them
Write local files only; nothing is sent or published

acceptanceCriteria.check: Every gap matches a source row below threshold
Cohort numbers match the raw scores
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceExpectation: Recomputed means and counts equal reported ones

acceptanceCriteria.check: Every support item points to a verified gap and a known activity
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceExpectation: All plan items reference existing gaps and intervention ids

acceptanceCriteria.check: No mentor is double-booked and capacity holds
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceExpectation: Zero overlaps, all sessions inside availability

acceptanceCriteria.check: Every draft is unsent and matches a booked session
Every booked session is one calendar event and nothing else
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceExpectation: Re-opened calendar has one event per booked session

acceptanceCriteria.check: The spreadsheet re-opens and its schedule rows equal the schedule file
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceExpectation: Re-opened sheet rows equal the schedule rows

acceptanceCriteria.check: The brief figures equal the counts in the files
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceExpectation: Stated at-risk, booked and unsent counts equal recomputed counts
